title: Full-Text Mirroring Policy

policy_values.meaning: Public repository shows metadata, summary and canonical link only.
Public repository may show short excerpts and canonical link.
Public repository may show an edited or expanded version, not a direct mirror.
Public repository or Docara site may publish the full text after explicit approval.
Material stays in ignored local workspace only.

recommended_next_step: Add per-publication `public_text_policy` to `data/publications.yml` before generating full public article pages.
